findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 1670, proof of citizenship to verify eligibility to vote
findings.note: She is listed as a coauthor of HB 1670 (author Leach), which would require documented proof of citizenship to register to vote, to the extent federal law allows. The bill was referred to the Elections committee on 2025-03-12.

findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 2245, verification of citizenship status of registered voters
findings.note: Listed as a coauthor of HB 2245 (author Leo Wilson), which deals with checking the citizenship status of people already registered to vote. The bill was referred to the Elections committee on 2025-03-14.

Listed as co of TX-HB-1670-2025 on the official Texas Legislature authors page (identity step 2026-10-28: printed name matched to one 89th Legislature member of that chamber, then to the roster by surname and first initial).
